'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2026 Iran war]]
**[[2026 Iranian strikes on Arab countries]]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Saudi Arabia]]
****An Iranian attack on [[Prince Sultan Air Base]] in [[Saudi Arabia]] with at least six ballistic missiles and 29 drones injures 15 [[United States Armed Forces|American soldiers]] and heavily damages a [[Boeing E-3 Sentry]] ([[AWACS]]) aircraft. ***[[Kuwait]], [[Saudi Arabia]], and the [[United Arab Emirates]] report that they have intercepted missile and [[Unmanned aerial vehicles in the Iranian military|drone attacks]] from [[Iran]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/3-gcc-states-say-they-intercepted-missiles-and-drones/3881144 (AA)]
**[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
***[[List of permanent representatives of Iran to the United Nations Office at Geneva|Iran's representative in Geneva]] {{ill|Ali Bahreini|fa|علی بحرینی (دیپلمات)}} says that [[Iran]] will facilitate and expedite humanitarian aid to cross the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. **[[2026 Iranian strikes on Israel]]
***One man is killed and several are injured by [[Iran]]ian [[ballistic missile program of Iran|ballistic missile]] attacks on [[central Israel|central]] and [[southern Israel]]. [https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-891444 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
**The [[Israeli Air Force]] strikes a [[uranium]] [[Nuclear program of Iran|processing facility]] in [[Yazd, Iran]]. There were no casualties or radiation leaks, according to [[Atomic Energy Organization of Iran|Iran's Atomic Energy Organization]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/3/27/israel-launches-strikes-on-iran-nuclear-sites-as-war-enters-fifth-week (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Iran]] has begun recruiting [[Adolescence|children]] as young as 12 to man [[Tehran]] checkpoints. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/iran-recruiting-children-as-young-as-12-to-man-tehran-checkpoints (''The Times of Israel'')] 

*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**The [[Sudan People's Liberation Movement–North]] reports that a [[Sudanese Armed Forces|Sudanese Army]] airstrike on a funeral gathering in the town of Al Sunut in [[South Kordofan]] has killed seven civilians and injured 39 others. [https://sudantribune.com/article/312161 (''Sudan Tribune'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
***[[Brent crude]] [[oil]] surpasses US$110 per [[barrel (unit)|barrel]] after Iran's [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy]] turned away three [[container ship]]s and declared the [[Strait of Hormuz]] closed. [https://www.scmp.com/news/world/middle-east/article/3348177/iran-says-hormuz-closed-shipping-and-enemy-ports (AFP via ''South China Morning Post'')] [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2026/03/27/iran-china-oil-prices-ships-blocked-strait-of-hormuz/6871774619526/ (UPI)] 
*[[Renationalization of YPF]]
**A [[United States]] [[United States courts of appeals|appeals court]] overturns a $16.1 billion judgment against [[Argentina]] related to the 2012 [[Nationalization of oil supplies|nationalization]] of oil company [[YPF]], ruling that the shareholders' claims are not valid under [[Law of Argentina|Argentine law]]. The decision reverses a 2023 [[United States district court|lower court]] ruling that had ordered compensation to minority investors. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260327-us-court-overturns-16-1-bn-judgment-against-argentina-over-oil-firm-seizure (AFP via France 24)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Calama school stabbing]]
**One person is killed and four others are injured in a [[mass stabbing]] at a school in [[Calama, Chile|Calama]], [[Antofagasta Region]], [[Chile]]. [https://abcnews.com/International/wireStory/school-stabbing-chile-leaves-1-dead-4-injured-131476134 (ABC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Nepalese general election]]
**Following his [[Rastriya Swatantra Party]]'s landslide victory in the general election, [[Balendra Shah]] is sworn as [[Prime Minister of Nepal]], succeeding interim prime minister [[Sushila Karki]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/ex-rapper-shah-sworn-nepal-prime-minister-after-sweeping-election-win-2026-03-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[Opposition to Vladimir Putin in Russia]]
**[[Russia]] designates filmmaker and teacher [[Pavel Talankin]], the co-director and subject of the 2025 documentary film ''[[Mr Nobody Against Putin]]'', as a [[Russian foreign agent law|foreign agent]] after authorities accuse him of spreading [[Russian disinformation|disinformation]] about [[Putin administration|the government]] and [[Protests against the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|opposing the war in Ukraine]]. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20260327-russia-labels-mr-nobody-against-putin-teacher-a-foreign-agent (AFP via RFI)]
*[[Protests against the 2026 Iran war]]
**Lawmakers from the [[Jammu & Kashmir National Conference]] protest outside the [[Jammu and Kashmir Legislative Assembly|legislative assembly]] of [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]], [[India]], in solidarity with [[Iran]] and against the [[Assassination of Ali Khamenei|assassination]] of former [[Supreme Leader of Iran|supreme leader]] [[Ali Khamenei]] amidst the Iran war. Additionally, a major confrontation breaks out between [[Indian National Congress|INC]] lawmaker [[Irfan Hafiz Lone]] and [[Bharatiya Janata Party|BJP]] lawmaker [[Yudhvir Sethi]] during the protest. [https://kashmirconvener.com/nc-lawmakers-protest-outside-jk-legislative-assembly-express-solidarity-with-iran-amid-tensions/ (''Kashmir Convener'')] [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/watch-massive-ruckus-in-jk-assembly-as-nc-mlas-protest-over-killing-of-irans-ali-khamenei/articleshow/129839452.cms (''Times of India'')]
*In [[Mongolia]], the [[State Great Khural]] accepts the [[resignation]] of [[Prime Minister of Mongolia|Prime Minister]] [[Gombojavyn Zandanshatar]]. [https://apnews.com/article/mongolia-prime-minister-resign-zandanshatar-boycott-687a953be2131d06c2a459699fd23fe1 (AP)]
